stage: V30 decision-conditional diagnosis before any new model or planner
population: All 73 V25 frozen roots. Diagnose the first legal public opportunity in each root, retaining the six empty roots and any missing histories. Add all six V29 first disagreements as separately tagged development cases, deduplicating identical root/clock histories. No selection by realized gain.
models: V25 model_fit.json unchanged: original20 and route_empirical20, 20-second grids. Existing fixed same-vehicle path and independent first-opportunity tail menus, original MCT and deadlines.
action_pairs: At a first-opportunity history, take the union of current/target pairs selected by the two frozen nominal single-target controls using only public history and model values; evaluate both models on each identical pair. A root without a future target still contributes its BOARD diagnostics. V29 cases use their frozen pair. Do not select a model by actual outcomes.
forecast: BOARD conditions on its currently visible departure, using the existing bracketed score projection off grid. Propagate the corresponding mixture of conditional distributions. Fixed-target WAIT conditions on no public departure since entry, keeping pre-entry, canceled and post-deadline mass. Tail selection is the original independent-trip first-offer rule. This is not rolling WAIT or optimal WAIT.
observations: Read future actual endpoints only after actions are fixed. Score conditional first arrival, target remaining wait, first-tail choice/wait, clipped total cost and paired action difference. Missing endpoint/identity remains unknown. Do not replace missing cost by a deadline loss.
scores: Conditional clock CRPS, mean bias, MAE of conditional mean and central 90-percent coverage/width; complete clipped-cost CRPS including failure mass at the deadline; binary Brier for choosing the first scheduled eligible reference tail (reference fixed from public clock, scheduled first-path duration and MCT). Report support, truncation/censoring and denominators. These are descriptive scores, not independent-date confidence intervals.
aggregation: Pair models on identical history/action/actual labels; report dates, root kinds, current/target roles and exact event identities. Root-history occurrences and unique trip/event counts are distinct. Main first-opportunity population and V29 development cases remain separate.
training_probe: Reproduce only the reported July25 within-route/kind/scheduled-duration centered dependency probe with groups n>=20. Record source and grouping, route9 estimates and independent-trip counts. It is exploratory, contains shared endpoints and cannot itself identify a causal recovery mechanism.

old_claims.V20: Three 60-second regret certificates only in the original fitted model, original policy and roots.
old_claims.V26: Subset DP optimal for its fixed boarding proxy; no full-network optimality.
old_claims.V27_V28: Single-target is a strong cheap baseline; realized benefit concentrated in developed OD0 blocks.
old_claims.V29: Fixed-pair full-integral rescue stopped. No reopening by increasing WAIT optimization.

decision: First resolve reproducible implementation or information errors if found. Otherwise use the paired component scores to locate which predictions lack support. A new conditional variable is not admitted from four losses or one training correlation; it needs consistent component evidence and a usable separated-date evaluation. If the present two developed dates cannot identify that change, conclude insufficient evidence, retain the frozen baselines and stop this stage without automatically expanding BOARD, menus, WAIT DP or tuning. Only a supported model plus a demonstrated residual policy gap can authorize that later mechanism study.
budget: One bounded diagnostic pass through the 67 first opportunities plus six V29 cases, at most two nominally selected pairs per first history and two frozen models. One existing-data training probe and read-only model-policy cross table. No downloads, refitting, new random worlds, new optimizer or independent confirmation claim. Record actual diagnostic costs, not a policy speedup.
date_status: July16/17 are developed retrospective dates; July23-29 already trained/developed. Other dates are not asserted available or independent without a new source/use audit.
